verdict.rationale: The Search API returns raw, ranked web results with content extraction and query-relevant snippets, and docs position it explicitly for your own downstream processing. Result count can be capped with max_results, and search context size controls how much web information is retrieved. Missing for 10: explicit token- or length-budget controls for sizing extracted content to an LLM context window, and independent or hands-on corroboration of result quality in RAG use.
